title: Vectors for Genetically-Encoded Tags for Electron Microscopy Contrast in Drosophila
author: Tsui, Itoh, et al.
materials: Drosophila cell lines were maintained according to standard protocols. Cells were transfected with 0.1–0.3 ug DNA using Effectene Transfection Reagent (QIAGEN) according to the manufacturer’s protocol. For induction of the metallothionein promoter, 0.2–0.5 mM copper sulphate (final concentration) was added 24 h post-transfection. Two days following transfection, the cells were harvested for confocal microscopy and photo-oxidation.

steps.title: Cell culture, transfection, and induction
steps.instruction: Maintain Drosophila cell lines, transfect with 0.1–0.3 µg DNA using Effectene (QIAGEN), add 0.2–0.5 mM CuSO₄ 24 h later, and harvest cells 2 days post‑transfection for microscopy.

substeps.instruction: Maintain Drosophila cells according to standard protocols.
Transfect cells with 0.1–0.3 µg DNA using Effectene Transfection Reagent (QIAGEN) following the manufacturer’s instructions.
Add copper sulphate to a final concentration of 0.2–0.5 mM 24 h after transfection to induce the metallothionein promoter.
Harvest cells two days after transfection for confocal microscopy and photo‑oxidation.

steps.title: Mitotracker staining
steps.instruction: Incubate harvested cells with 250 nM Mitotracker Red for 30 min at room temperature, wash once with medium, and observe immediately under a microscope.

substeps.instruction: Incubate cells in culture medium containing 250 nM Mitotracker Red (Molecular Probes) for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Wash cells once with fresh medium.
Observe cells immediately under a microscope.
